prompts.editorial:
Use case logo-brand. Create one original premium logo exploration board for DrawPacket, concept "Editorial Cut". Landscape1536×1024 flat precise design. Attached selected website image is mood reference only: chalk #F5F5F1, oxblood #642A37, ink #252225, refined editorial typography. Do not copy calendar, timeline, OCT tab or old logo.
This direction is WORDMARK FIRST. No separate symbol next to main wordmark. Create a beautiful custom DrawPacket typographic logo, exact capitalization D and P, one word. A confident moderately narrow contemporary serif with sturdy stroke contrast, elegant open lowercase a/e, carefully drawn distinctive D, P and k, generous optical kerning rather than letterspacing. Unique signature is one subtle diagonal cut through the upper bowl terminal of the capital P, suggesting the step where a record moves into review. Integrate the cut naturally into P, not a slash crossing letters. The rest of wordmark remains exceptionally readable. It should feel like an established premium publisher merged with precise financial software, not fashion magazine hairlines, Times New Roman pasted text, or a law firm. NO standalone D or DP monogram, open-D symbol, brackets, dot-in-brackets, folder, calendar, shield, checkmark, circle arrow, stamps or construction roof.
Main upper two-thirds: enormous beautifully spaced "DrawPacket" in oxblood on chalk with tons of breathing room. Small top-left label "DrawPacket / Logo exploration" and top-right "Editorial Cut". Small caption "The name carries the identity." Bottom third three clean presentation areas: "Detail" enlarged crop of custom capital P and its intentional single cut; "Monochrome" exact same wordmark in black then reversed chalk on flat oxblood; "In use" same wordmark at small navigation scale on simple flat masthead plus square favicon containing ONLY the custom cut P, not DP. No made-up fonts named or exact size claims. Consistency of the special P is essential in every rendering. Flat colors, no texture, gradients, embossing, fake stationery or photography. Board is a logo design concept, not a complete website, not a legal clearance claim. The business is review of monthly construction draw evidence, not automatic payment or guaranteed compliance. Do not add slogans other than supplied caption. Single identity direction only.
prompts.gather:
Use case logo-brand. One new high-end logo concept board for DrawPacket titled "Gather". Landscape1536×1024. Use attached Cycle Study website ONLY as palette/mood grounding: chalk #F5F5F1, oxblood #642A37, ink #252225, quiet editorial sophistication. Do not reproduce its logo, calendar or screen. New original abstract identity. No D, DP or P monogram.
Symbol: three substantial parallel vertical strokes with slightly staggered upper ends, each curves gently inward near the base to gather into ONE shared flat horizontal foot. Overall shape resembles a compact gathered sheaf or three records becoming one review, but not a literal folder, book, paperclip, hand, crown, trident, wheat plant, fountain or finance bar chart. Achieve a distinctive organic-geometric silhouette, almost like a custom printer's mark: restrained taper and curved interior channels with square optical terminals. Three paths enter, one base holds them. Open channels wide enough for small mark. No fourth stroke, no tiny details, no hairlines. Render in solid oxblood. Make it elegant, balanced and unusually memorable, not a generic app icon.
Pair with exact wordmark "DrawPacket" capital D and P, no space, clean contemporary HUMANIST SANS with gently tapered details, medium weight and highly refined spacing. The sans wordmark should feel sophisticated next to selected website's tall serif headlines: logo does not have to be serif. No overly rounded friendly startup font, no bulky geometric type. Main horizontal lockup symbol plus wordmark large at upper-middle; symbol about cap-height, not huge.
Top-left small "DrawPacket / Logo exploration", top-right "Gather". Small caption "Many records. One review."
Bottom third neatly divided with fine grey rules: "Symbol" large SAME standalone mark; "Monochrome" exact mark and wordmark black-on-white and reversed white-on-oxblood; "In use" masthead sized wordmark/mark and small square app/favicon concept. All instances must have exactly same three paths and same geometry. Generous negative space, sophisticated minimal proportions.
Business is a research-stage monthly construction draw evidence-review product, not a payment bank. No approval guarantee, no shield/checkmark, roof/crane/calendar/circular arrow/infinity/brackets/dots/stamp. No borrowed logos, embossed stationery, photos, 3D, shadows, textures or gradients. Flat sharp vector-like logo artwork. One coherent identity direction, not a collage of different marks.
prompts.cadence:
Use case logo-brand. Design an original premium DrawPacket logo identity board, single direction "Cadence". Landscape1536×1024. The attached website is mood reference only: elegant Cycle Study editorial world, chalk #F5F5F1, oxblood #642A37, ink #252225 and pale lilac #DFDBE8. Do not use its logo, calendar tab or any screen UI. Create a NEW symbol, not D/DP/P letters, brackets, gathered3-line mark or serif wordmark only.
Concept: monthly review periods follow one another; a deliberate pause separates evidence from the next decision. Signature symbol consists of TWO identical solid capsule-shaped vertical forms, each with a single precisely sliced oblique negative-space slit across the middle. The pair is staggered vertically by one modest step: first a little higher, second a little lower. Use expressive sharp cut faces and softly rounded outside ends, distinctive rhythmic compact overall silhouette. The two cuts align visually along an oblique baseline, creating cadence and progression WITHOUT an arrow. Two simple pieces side by side, broad white channels, no thin lines. Not an infinity loop, payment chain, pill brand, equal sign, pause media control or chevron. Optical refinement and slight nonmechanical width make the emblem distinctive. Pure oxblood, flat, small-size readable. Do not add a circular enclosure.
Pair with precise exact wordmark "DrawPacket" capital D and P no space. Typography a contemporary sturdy low-contrast editorial SLAB SERIF, medium weight with softly bracketed short serifs, open a/e, optically spaced. Avoid fashion Didone, hairlines, Times New Roman, bulky western slab and generic geometric sans. Logo should feel authoritative, modern and calm, complementing tall elegant serif page headlines. Main symbol+wordmark in upper two-thirds, ample whitespace, balanced cap-height relationship. Ink wordmark, oxblood symbol.
Top small labels "DrawPacket / Logo exploration" and "Cadence". Caption "A clear rhythm for each draw."
Bottom three blocks separated by subtle light rules: Symbol standalone large EXACT same two-piece staggered symbol; Monochrome black on chalk and white reversed on oxblood logo lockup; In use a small simple navigation masthead and favicon with precisely same mark geometry. No clutter, only one concept, no arrows, calendars, clocks, roofs, folders, shields, checks, dots/brackets, stamps, photo mockups, 3D, embossing, shadows, textures or gradients. Strong original contemporary design with impeccable spacing. All versions match, no invented savings/certification claims. A polished raster concept presentation, not final vector or clearance.
